answer_2.quote: We evaluate model predictions using Exact Match (EM) and Intersection over Union (IoU) metrics...compute macro ROUGE-L between predicted and annotated triggers...evaluate Arg-I using the F1 score.

answer_4.quote: To assess human performance for comparison with models, we additionally recruit six untrained annotators to independently annotate...Intercoder reliability, measured by Cohen's Kappa, is 0.83...resulting in full team consensus.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators followed a collaborative, multi-round, discussion-based annotation process with specific rules in the Codebook (Appendix B.4) for resolving disagreements on span variations and argument roles.
